purpose: Make historical walk-forward research the primary three-session strategy iteration engine while retaining genuinely future observations as a separate confirmation and drift-monitoring layer.

user_directive.requirement: Use the existing historical data with explicit training, validation, and backtest partitions instead of waiting for one newly completed daily observation to perform each research iteration.
user_directive.reason: A future-only stream adds roughly one signal session per accepted trading day and is too slow to support factor construction, parameter search, combination research, and efficient strategy iteration.

future_only_policy_remains_binding_for: candidate49 signal, execution, and evaluation ledgers
the prohibition on candidate49 historical return backfill
future_only_policy_no_longer_means: all historical factor research must stop while candidate49 is active
one newly completed session is the primary strategy-development sample
historical factor construction, parameter search, or combination research must wait for candidate49 to reach 200 completed signals
historical_trials_are_not: a second active future signal ledger
permission for current scoring, stock selection, sizing, orders, or live trading

historical_evidence_classification.not_pristine_reason: The 2019-2025 market outcomes were already examined across forty-eight terminal mechanisms and many recorded variants. A new split improves discipline and efficiency but cannot retroactively make those market returns unseen.
historical_evidence_classification.allowed_claim: Historical walk-forward results may rank and reject research candidates and estimate robustness under the fixed execution assumptions.
historical_evidence_classification.forbidden_claim: No 2019-2025 result may be described as a pristine untouched holdout or sufficient proof of live profitability.

allowed_uses: window, transform, threshold, and filter search

locked_historical_backtest.opening_rule: Before reading this interval for a campaign, freeze the complete candidate library, parent/version graph, formulas, directions, parameter-search bounds, selection rule, combination method, fitting method, costs, gates, and data/code fingerprints.
locked_historical_backtest.consumption_rule: Open the interval once for the whole frozen campaign, record every candidate result, and mark the campaign lockbox consumed.
locked_historical_backtest.after_consumption_rule: Any formula, parameter, subset, filter, weight, or combination proposed after viewing the campaign result is a new exploratory version and may not call the same 2024-2025 interval untouched or pristine.

prospective_confirmation.use: Confirm portability and monitor decay after a historical candidate survives the frozen campaign; do not make daily accumulation the primary factor-discovery loop.

three_session_leakage_controls.entry: next accepted local session open t+1
three_session_leakage_controls.exit: third accepted local session close t+3
three_session_leakage_controls.label_containment: A signal belongs to a partition only when its t+1 entry and t+3 exit are both inside that partition.
three_session_leakage_controls.boundary_rule: Drop every otherwise valid signal whose label window crosses a training, validation, or backtest boundary.
three_session_leakage_controls.overlap_rule: Use the frozen non-overlapping three-session research grid for association comparisons and use the shared cash-constrained portfolio replay for executable performance.
three_session_leakage_controls.future_information_rule: Features, universe membership, quality fields, and event availability must remain point-in-time at signal close.

trial_and_multiplicity_ledger.counting_rule: Record every attempted formula, direction, parameter set, subset, filter, model, and combination, including failures and infrastructure-only failures; never retain only the best result.
trial_and_multiplicity_ledger.version_rule: Any change after viewing validation or locked-backtest results creates a new immutable trial version linked to its parent.
trial_and_multiplicity_ledger.selection_bias_rule: Report the number of attempted trials with every surviving result and treat increasingly searched performance as exploratory unless it later survives genuinely future evidence.

historical_search_permissions.reuse_of_terminal_factor_definitions_as_: allowed only when the complete reused feature library and search space are frozen for the campaign; prior terminal records remain terminal and are not erased or reclassified as passers

fixed_execution_assumptions.portfolio: one shared cash-constrained portfolio with overlapping positions and no use of future sale proceeds at an earlier same-day open
fixed_execution_assumptions.blocked_exit: retain the position and retry under the frozen execution policy

required_views: walk-forward Rank IC and positive-IC rate
shared-portfolio net return after fixed costs
selection_objective.principle: Prefer simple mechanisms that remain directionally and economically consistent across folds over a single high pooled backtest.

promotion_and_live_boundary.historical_campaign_pass_result: eligible only for a separately fingerprinted prospective champion registration

forbidden_actions: backfill candidate49 historical returns, signals, executions, or milestones
describe 2019-2025 or 2024-2025 as a pristine untouched market holdout
tune a campaign on 2024-2025 and still report the same interval as its locked test
omit failed trials or search attempts from the append-only ledger
use a historical pass as direct permission for a current score, stock list, position size, paper order, or live order
change the fixed three-session timing or execution costs after opening a locked campaign backtest without creating a new version
erase or rewrite the forty-eight terminal records
start a second prospective ledger while candidate49 remains the active prospective candidate

next_implementation_action.objective: Implement an offline, fingerprint-bound historical walk-forward campaign runner and append-only trial ledger before opening a new 2024-2025 campaign backtest.
required_order: inventory and freeze the first finite candidate and combination library
record every development and validation trial
freeze the survivor rule and the whole campaign
open the 2024-2025 quasi-out-of-sample campaign backtest once
record all results and mark the lockbox consumed
register at most one surviving champion for genuinely future confirmation
